design: Frozen H757 learned correlation-initialized overlapping groups, all3 scalar dictionaries and3 degree-preserving rewires per dictionary. Compare scalar8 and full-head references. Decode two selected groups through exact union of shared atoms, same select_pairs gate as training evaluation; no task optimization. Reconstruct endpoints separately then add F(donor)-F(receiver) to native L5H3/H5 at both selected positions. Compare total, full-QK-node-dependent and compact-operation-dependent effects as H756. All240 H747 contexts; native competence retained.
limitations: Reused task panel. Fixed dictionary/energy-based grouping, not joint learned gates. Degree controls preserve membership counts but not anchor designation. Mean errors across seeds not independent statistical replication. Spherical downstream clamp includes complement correction.
